description: Improve a slow API endpoint by identifying the bottleneck and applying a measurable optimization.
requirements: Repository should identify the slow endpoint or operation being optimized
Repository should include before and after performance evidence such as timings, benchmark output or load test results
Optimization should address a real bottleneck such as inefficient queries, repeated network calls, missing indexes or excessive computation
API response contract should remain compatible unless the breaking change is clearly documented
Automated tests or documented manual checks should verify the endpoint still works correctly
README.md or commit message should explain the performance improvement
title: Improve Slow API Performance
